tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Check whether MoneyMoney is running and its database unlocked. Call this first when other tools report errors.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List all MoneyMoney accounts with their current balances. Use this first to discover account names, IBANs or numbers for other tools.

mask_ids.description: Mask IBANs/account numbers. Omit for the server default (MONEYMONEY_MASK_IDS env, off unless set); pass false to reveal full numbers even when masking is on by default.

tools.name: get_transactions
tools.description: Get MoneyMoney transactions, newest first. Category UUIDs are resolved to names and full paths.

account.description: Account UUID, IBAN, number, name or group name.

category.description: Category UUID or name ("A\B" for nested).

mask_ids.description: Mask IBANs/account numbers. Omit for the server default (MONEYMONEY_MASK_IDS env, off unless set); pass false to reveal full numbers even when masking is on by default.

tools.name: search_transactions
tools.description: Search transactions by counterparty/purpose substring and amount range, newest first.

account.description: Account UUID, IBAN, number, name or group name.

category.description: Category UUID or name ("A\B" for nested).

counterparty.description: Case-insensitive substring of the counterparty name.

purpose.description: Case-insensitive substring of the purpose text.

mask_ids.description: Mask IBANs/account numbers. Omit for the server default (MONEYMONEY_MASK_IDS env, off unless set); pass false to reveal full numbers even when masking is on by default.

tools.name: get_portfolio
tools.description: Get securities holdings (depot positions) with current values.

account.description: Account UUID, IBAN, number, name or group name.

tools.name: top_counterparties
tools.description: Rank counterparties by activity with per-currency totals. With convert_to, totals convert at ECB rates and ranking uses them.

account.description: Account UUID, IBAN, number, name or group name.

convert_to.description: ISO code for converted ranking, e.g. "EUR".

tools.name: get_recurring
tools.description: Detect subscriptions and recurring payments with cadence labels (weekly/biweekly/monthly/quarterly/semiannual/yearly/irregular).

from_date.description: Start date (default: 90 days ago; use a year for yearly items).

account.description: Account UUID, IBAN, number, name or group name.

tools.name: compare_periods
tools.description: Compare two date ranges side by side (counts and per-currency totals).

account.description: Account UUID, IBAN, number, name or group name.

tools.name: get_category_total
tools.description: Sum + count for one category or a whole subtree. Pass exactly one of category (leaf name or full path) or prefix (path prefix).

account.description: Account UUID, IBAN, number, name or group name.

tools.name: list_statements
tools.description: List electronic bank statements MoneyMoney downloaded, newest first.

account.description: Only statements from this account folder.

tools.name: cashflow_timeline
tools.description: Income vs expenses vs net per period, oldest first. Answers whether saving is going up or down without dumping transactions.

account.description: Account UUID, IBAN, number, name or group name.

tools.name: get_budgets
tools.description: Compare per-category budgets against actual spend. Defaults to the current month to align with monthly budgets.

from_date.description: Start date (default: first of this month).

tools.name: get_statement
tools.description: Read one electronic bank statement with extracted text. The `extraction` field reports full/partial/unavailable quality.

mask_ids.description: Mask IBANs/account numbers. Omit for the server default (MONEYMONEY_MASK_IDS env, off unless set); pass false to reveal full numbers even when masking is on by default.
